about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement

labels: enhancement

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves
Explain what problem this feature would solve or what use case it addresses.

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request.

## CrowdStrike Monitoring Relevance
- [ ] Adds new monitoring source
- [ ] Improves data parsing
- [ ] Enhances notification system
- [ ] Other: [please specify]

## Implementation Priority
- [ ] Critical - System broken without it
- [ ] High - Significantly improves functionality
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Minor enhancement
